NO

The plan omits the `scale = alpha / r = 2` factor when computing the delta — it simply adds raw `B @ A` instead of `2 * B @ A`, as the comment itself admits ("defect: the alpha / r scale is missing"). This violates Required Result clause 1, which mandates `weight += scale * B @ A`, and will fail the grading tolerance (relative Frobenius error ≤ 1e-5) for all 32 merged weights.
